title: Unit Event — Happy Enjoy Music! — Episode8 Fun and Happy

meta.Event Outline: With their new song released, Leo/need looks forward to Jam Fest. Saki, nervous before her first festival, encounters a familiar face...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But what do I do?
What should I play...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It seems like you're allowed to play whatever you want here, but if I'm really gonna do this, I want everyone to have fun...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Shh... Not so loud. The others are going to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I was going to ask how the festival went, but it looks like I picked the perfect timing. Now I get to hear you play.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But you do seem a little nervous...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I was asked to play all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm wondering which song would make everyone here the happiest.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <In that case, why don't you just play what you want, Saki?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If you don't know what their musical preferences are, then I think you should just play what you like.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Because I have a feeling that they'll really enjoy seeing you having fun while playing.>

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
Thanks for your patience!
You're up next, right? Come on up♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good luck, Saki.
I know you'll do great.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks... Make sure you listen, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (A song that I have fun playing...)

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: No idea, but I kinda like it!

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Wait, I think I know this one. It goes like...

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line:
Hey, I like this melody.
And I think I get the basic idea now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hearing me play the piano is making everyone smile, laugh and sing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki looks like she's having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, despite being so nervous a second ago, she's playing great.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Everyone's smiling, and they're all right there.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm the one playing, but we're all singing and having fun together.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...!
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I don't know why, but this is so...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I can see everyone in front of me smiling, and I know that music is connecting us all together...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Our high schoolers here need to go home. Plus, that festival probably took a lot out of them, so they need to rest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and our parents will likely start worrying if we don't get home soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, nice performances today.
And thank you for introducing this great cafe to us.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Hope we get to play together again soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I, uhh...! I really appreciate you giving us advice during the festival, and introducing this wonderful cafe to us... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks to you, today ended up being so so so so sooo much fun!!!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to say that.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'm glad I got to hear Leo/need perform that song live, and see you have so much fun, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: We're gonna leave you if you don't hurry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line:
Today ended up being so fun.
And tons of people came to see us perform at the festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo even gave us his seal of approval. I can't wait to do our next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Me neither! Where do you think we'll get to play next?!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's ask Mr. Shindo that the next time we see him.
